what: N cutout product photos are laid out on a circle around a square board — each position is i/N·2π, centered = Half panel, radius = Plate half-width minus item half-width, and each item is rotated by offset + i × step degrees (default 270 + i × 360/N), so the chair direction changes along the circle. The group fades in from from-scale (small circle 1.2, large circle .9) and transparent to 1x over 1.5s cubic-bezier(.25,.46,.45,.94), then after 1.5s the whole plate spins one turn with no curve at spin seconds (small circle 250, large circle 150). On receiving fx:leave, the group grows to 1.2x and fades out over 1s cubic-bezier(.32,.48,.27,1.02) — plate sizes are layered to make double and triple circles

options.[data-fx-part=item]: Item placed on the circle (photo, cutout). Size is --fx-item (default 16% of the panel width) — if the item must be larger than the panel, give it in vw
options.[data-fx-part=wrap]: (If present) panel that groups the sections, grows and turns on. If absent, the motion part creates it
options.step: Extra rotation per section (degrees), default 360/N — original small circle 24, large circle 12
options.from: Start scale on entry, default 1.2 (original large circle .9)
options.delay: Enter and exit delay (sec), default 0 (original small circle .1)
options.spin-delay: Seconds from enter start until rotation, default 1.5
options.wait: Comes in after a document event of this name (end of loader — fx:done of crawl-draw-loader bubbles up to the document)

note: The spin is a CSS animation (the panel’s transform), so no other transform is applied to the panel itself — position shifts go on the outer panel. The original stops the spin when the window is resized, restarts it after 1.5s and re-measures positions. The part only re-measures positions with ResizeObserver
use: …

from.where: index.html .vf-ring (original Hero double ring of chair photos — small ring 15 photos step 24 · from 1.2 · delay .1 · 250s, large ring 30 photos step 12 · from .9 · 150s, pressing Start grows it 1.2x and fades it out)
